_comment: THE CAR MEET. Where the cars park, and nothing else.
EVERY NUMBER IN HERE WAS STOOD ON. Each spot is a coordinate and a heading read off
the screen while parked in it -- not measured off a map, not derived from anything.
That is the only way this mod has ever got a coordinate right, and a car park is
twelve of them in a row where being a metre out is the difference between a line of
cars and a pile-up.
THE HEADING IS THE HALF THAT MATTERS. A spot with the right position and the wrong
heading is a car parked across two bays. They are written to three decimals for the
same reason: half a degree over eight metres of car is a nose sticking out.
ROLES.
park    an ordinary space. The car drives in, parks, and sits there.
crowd   where everybody ends up. Nobody parks here -- the drivers get out, walk
over and stand about talking. One spot; they arrange themselves round it.
hop     the one on juice. A lowrider, green, green neons, bouncing on hydraulics --
see Locations/CarMeet.cs. It is out on its own away from the row because
that is where the crowd stands, and because a car on hydraulics next to a
parked one is a car hitting a parked one.
ADDING A SPOT is a line in here and nothing else. Park where you want it, read the
four numbers off the screen, and put them in. The meet fills as many spaces as it
finds and never spawns more cars than there are places to put them.
